title: Fix stale report filename captions and cover language resolution
summary: Fixed a bug where the report filename resolver incorrectly returned true for nonexistent reports when the output value was already populated, and added language resolution coverage with regression tests.
key_points: Clear output value before metadata lookup so nonexistent/zero report IDs correctly return false instead of true
Report name caption now reads metadata under the selected GlobalLanguage through Language.GetLanguageIdOrDefault
Nine new AL regression tests cover explicit language selection, blank-code company defaults, language restoration, translated captions, and nonexistent reports
Two test-only report objects and checked-in German translation resource enable testing without relying on installed Base Application translations
Implementation comment clarified to distinguish metadata resource selection from report's effective rendering language
quote: Clear the output before resolving so nonexistent/zero report IDs return false and empty output.
